title: Ciphertext skip-transition position prior
rationale: This lane preregisters a ciphertext-only structural rule before any source-backed observation scoring. It does not tune on public anchor-derived additive fragments, candidate words, key material, routed fragments, or held-out public anchors; it can only become evidence if later independent non-anchor observations align with the predeclared skip-transition positions under null controls.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in positions selected by a predeclared skip-transition pressure rule over ciphertext-only adjacent and two-step letter transitions.
discovery_inputs: K4 ciphertext sequence restricted to the predeclared non-anchor position universe
Predeclared skip-transition pressure rule using adjacent and distance-two ciphertext-letter transitions
Non-anchor position universe fixed before any source-backed observation scoring
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Validated source-review files and observation files with source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale declared before scoring
Position-only evaluation target that excludes public anchor-derived additive fragments as primary evidence
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position-set shuffle baseline
multiple-comparison correction across any declared skip distances or transition ranks
require-unique-artifact gate over the deterministic ciphertext skip-transition prediction artifact
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat the preregistered null controls without post-hoc retuning
